instructions: Read every complete case in the paired workbook. The default is only a draft. Put a full Decision object in Override for every contradiction, then sign reviewedAllCases. The compiler refuses unsigned or candidate-less rows.

rows.Kwic: 為國開堂，舉揚宗教，山僧不敢囊藏被葢

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄, Yuanwu Keqin's imperial-command opening of Chongning Monastery. Yuanwu Keqin is the exact speaker: he says that in opening the hall for the country he raises the lineage teaching and will not conceal what buddhas cannot exhaust and patriarchs cannot lift.

rows.Kwic: 如王寶劍，殺活臨時

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄, Mi'an Xianjie's imperial-command hall address. Mi'an Xianjie is the exact speaker: he compares non-arising understanding to a royal sword whose killing and giving-life occur according to the moment.

rows.Kwic: 人人鼻孔遼天，各各壁立千仞。

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄, Fori Yue's incense-reception hall address. Fori Yue is the exact speaker: he says that buddhas and living beings interpenetrate, self and other are equal, everyone's nostrils pierce the sky, and each stands like a thousand-fathom wall.

rows.Kwic: 未免面皮厚三寸。且道靈隱恁麼批判，意在什麼處？

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄, Fozhao Deguang's hall address after receiving his title. Fozhao Deguang is the exact commenting speaker: after raising Huangbo's no-Chan-master exchange, he says Huangbo still has facial skin three inches thick.

rows.Kwic: 眾中更無一人有衲僧氣息。諸人還見世尊以手摩胸麼？

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄, Dai'an Zhuang's hall address raising Shakyamuni touching his chest. Dai'an Zhuang is the exact commentator who says that among the millions in the assembly not one possessed the breath of a patch-robed monk.

rows.Kwic: ，建立乖真。若到者裏，纖毫不受，指意則差。便是千聖出頭來，也安一字不得。久立，珍重。長慶稜禪師。上堂，良久曰：莫道今夜較些子。便下座。上堂：撞著道伴交肩過，一生參學事畢。上堂：淨潔打疊了也，却近前問我覓，我劈脊與你一棒。有一棒到你，你

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄 explicitly introduces Changqing Huileng immediately before the stored turn. Changqing is the exact speaker: after a long silence he says, 'do not say that tonight is a little short.'

rows.Kwic: 若無如許多惡覺情見想習之事，譬如秋水澄渟，清淨無為，澹泞無礙。喚他作道人，亦名無事人。

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄 explicitly identifies Guishan Lingyou as the hall speaker. Guishan says that one free of evil perceptions, emotional views, concepts, and habits is called a person of the Way and also an unconcerned person.

rows.Kwic: 成一塊，輥向須彌頂上。帝釋大怒，拈得撲成粉碎。諸上座還覺頭痛也無？良久曰：莫不識痛痒好！珍重！承天確禪師示眾：正令提綱，猶是揑窠造偽。佛法祇對，特地謾驀上流。問著即參差，答著即交互。大德擬向甚麼處下口？然則如是，事無一向，權

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄 explicitly introduces Chan Master Chengtian Que's instruction. Chengtian Que is the exact speaker who says that raising the true command as guiding principle still fabricates a nest.

rows.Kwic: 夫宗師者，奪貧子之衣珠，究達人之見處。

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄, Daowu Wuzhen's sequence of hall addresses. Daowu Wuzhen is the exact speaker who defines a lineage master as taking the poor son's robe-jewel and penetrating an accomplished person's standpoint.

rows.Kwic: 智海拄杖，或作金剛王寶劍，或作踞地獅子，或作探竿影草，或不作拄杖用。

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄, Dagui Zhe's sequence of hall addresses. Dagui Zhe is the exact speaker: raising the Zhihai staff, he says it may function as the diamond king's precious sword, a crouching lion, a sounding-pole and shadow-grass, or not as a staff.

rows.Kwic: 莫謂無心云是道，無心猶隔一重關。示眾，云：泥佛不度水，木佛不度火，金佛不度爐，真佛內裏坐。

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄, Yuantong Daomin's hall-address sequence, identified by the self-reference 圓通. Yuantong is the exact speaker who warns not to call no-mind the Way because no-mind still lies beyond one heavy barrier.

rows.Kwic: 若點檢得出，須彌南畔把手共行；若點檢不出，布袋裏老鴉雖活如死。

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄 explicitly introduces Chan Master Jianfu Ben's hall address. Jianfu Ben is the exact speaker who says that anyone able to examine his statement may walk hand in hand south of Mount Sumeru.

rows.Kwic: 當處出生，隨處滅盡，是活生受底規模。

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄, Baofeng Weizhao's continuing sequence of hall addresses. Baofeng Weizhao is the exact speaker who contrasts being originally unborn and now unextinguished with arising here and being extinguished wherever one goes.

rows.Kwic: 憐鵝護雪，只是應時應節不失其宜，大盡三十日、小盡二十九，饑餐渴飲，任運騰騰，佛界不收、魔界不攝，直得皇風蕩蕩、帝道平平，野老謳謌、

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄 explicitly introduces Mi'an Xianjie's end-of-retreat informal address. Mi'an is the exact speaker who describes eating when hungry and drinking when thirsty, proceeding freely and buoyantly beyond capture by buddha or demon realms.

rows.Kwic: 是汝諸人須是皮下有血始得。畢竟如何？

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄, Gulin Qingmao's end-of-retreat informal address. Gulin is the exact speaker who says that his own report is private salt sold on the public road and that the listeners must have blood beneath the skin.

rows.Kwic: 五六年來雖則與諸人眉毛廝結，其實水米無交

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄, Liao'an Qingyu's sequence of winter-solstice informal addresses. Liao'an is the exact speaker who says that for five or six years he and the assembly have intertwined eyebrows while in fact having no exchange of water or rice.

rows.Kwic: 師云：藥山老漢得恁老婆心切。進云：且那裏是他老婆心切處？

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄 explicitly introduces Yu'an Zhiji's New Year's Eve informal address. Yu'an Zhiji is the exact speaker who comments that old Yaoshan was so earnestly grandmotherly in offering the monk a food-abstention formula.

rows.Kwic: 山河大地、明暗色空總在山僧拄杖頭上

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄, Gulin Qingmao's continuing New Year's Eve addresses. Gulin is the exact speaker: lifting his staff, he says mountains, rivers, earth, light, dark, form, and emptiness are all atop it.

rows.Kwic: 觸目遇緣，隨處明了，何曾昧却？

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄 explicitly introduces Chan Master Shuzhong Wenyun's New Year's Eve informal address. Shuzhong is the exact speaker who says that through the year the listeners meet conditions before their eyes and understand wherever they are.

rows.Kwic: 滯於情解、昧於識度

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄, Zhongfeng Mingben's memorial instruction for Zhao Mengfu. Zhongfeng is the exact author who says that many scholar-officials engaged in questioning and encounter dialogue remained stuck in emotional interpretation and obscured in discernment.

rows.Kwic: 直須眉毛廝結，同生同死。

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄 explicitly introduces Ying'an Tanhua's arrival address at Changlu. Ying'an is the exact speaker who says that merely seeing the banner across the river is insufficient and that one must intertwine eyebrows, living and dying together.

rows.Kwic: 分宗列派，各立門庭。

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄 explicitly introduces Nanshi Wenxiu's installation at Wanshou. Nanshi is the exact speaker who says that teachers throughout the world divide into lineages and schools and each establishes a house gate.

rows.Kwic: 久立眾慈，伏惟珍重。下座。

Override.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄, Folang Xing's end-of-retreat whisk address. Folang is the exact speaker who closes his own appraisal of Dongshan's verse by looking over the assembly, shouting, warning against speaking dreams before fools, and saying farewell.
